wolf: Current installed Wolf skin on Fox rig, verified byte-for-byte against build-cmake/mods/wolfen.o2r. Head remains WIP.
notes: Preserves original N64 units and Y-up coordinates.
GLB uses rigid animated limb nodes rather than a weighted skin.
Root translation is fixed to the limb origin, matching game modes 1/5.
N64 lighting/combiners and runtime character pose overrides are not reproduced.
Native assets preserve original animation data.
